name: Corn & Soybean Backwardation/Contango Regime Analysis
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in ZC (corn) and ZS (soybeans) using futures continuation carry (M1/M2 - 1) as the curve slope signal. Three regimes: extreme backwardation (carry > 5%), moderate backwardation (0% < carry ≤ 5%), and contango (carry < 0%). Shows: (1) expanding hit rate lines for each backwardation tier vs 50% coin-flip baseline, (2) quintile sort on carry (rolling 252-day percentrank, Q1=deepest contango, Q5=deepest backwardation) with avg 63d forward carry and hit rate by quintile for both ZC and ZS, (3) regime-colored carry time series, (4) seasonal heatmaps showing % of days in each carry quintile by calendar month for ZC and ZS. Uses NoAdjustment for both contracts to preserve true price levels. Study period covers 2010–present to capture the 2012 drought and 2020–2022 commodity rally.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN & SOYBEAN BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO REGIME ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
#
# Signal: cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1
#   Positive = backwardation (front > deferred) → roll yield positive
#   Negative = contango (front < deferred)      → roll yield negative
#
# THREE REGIMES:
#   Extreme backwardation  (carry > 5%)          → Blue
#   Moderate backwardation (0% < carry <= 5%)    → Cyan
#   Contango               (carry < 0%)          → Red
#
# Predictive test: does each backwardation tier predict positive carry 63d ahead?
#   Hit rate = % of regime days where forward_carry_63d > 0
#
# NoAdjustment for both ZC and ZS — preserves true price levels for carry signals.
# ZS loaded via reference_futures → futures_continuation (proper front-month).
# Period: 2010–present (captures 2012 drought, 2020–2022 commodity rally).
# =============================================================================

# --- ZC (Corn): Primary asset ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- ZS (Soybeans): Reference asset via continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Regime flags: THREE regimes ---
# ZC
zc_extreme_back  = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0.05           # carry > 5%
zc_moderate_back = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0 and zc_carry <= 0.05  # 0% < carry <= 5%
zc_in_backwardation = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0            # any backwardation
zc_in_contango      = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry < 0

# ZS
zs_extreme_back  = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry > 0.05
zs_moderate_back = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry > 0 and zs_carry <= 0.05
zs_in_backwardation = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry > 0
zs_in_contango      = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry < 0

# --- Regime-colored carry series (NaN when not in that regime) ---
# ZC: extreme back = Blue, moderate back = Cyan, contango = Red
zc_carry_extreme = where(zc_extreme_back, zc_carry)
zc_carry_mod     = where(zc_moderate_back, zc_carry)
zc_carry_cont    = where(zc_in_contango, zc_carry)

# ZS
zs_carry_extreme = where(zs_extreme_back, zs_carry)
zs_carry_mod     = where(zs_moderate_back, zs_carry)
zs_carry_cont    = where(zs_in_contango, zs_carry)

# --- Forward carry: 63-day ahead carry value (next quarter) ---
zc_fwd_carry_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(zc_carry)
zs_fwd_carry_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(zs_carry)

# --- Regime-conditional forward carry (three regimes) ---
# ZC
zc_fwd_extreme = where(zc_extreme_back, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_mod     = where(zc_moderate_back, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_cont    = where(zc_in_contango, zc_fwd_carry_63)

# ZS
zs_fwd_extreme = where(zs_extreme_back, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_mod     = where(zs_moderate_back, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_cont    = where(zs_in_contango, zs_fwd_carry_63)

# --- Hit rate: each backwardation tier predicting positive next-quarter carry ---
# Expanding hit rate = cumulative hits / (hits + misses) within that regime

# Extreme backwardation — ZC
zc_ext_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_extreme) and zc_fwd_extreme > 0) else 0.0
zc_ext_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_extreme) and zc_fwd_extreme <= 0) else 0.0
zc_ext_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_ext_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_ext_miss)
zc_hit_rate_extreme = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_ext_hit) / zc_ext_denom

# Moderate backwardation — ZC
zc_mod_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_mod) and zc_fwd_mod > 0) else 0.0
zc_mod_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_mod) and zc_fwd_mod <= 0) else 0.0
zc_mod_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_mod_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_mod_miss)
zc_hit_rate_mod = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_mod_hit) / zc_mod_denom

# Extreme backwardation — ZS
zs_ext_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_extreme) and zs_fwd_extreme > 0) else 0.0
zs_ext_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_extreme) and zs_fwd_extreme <= 0) else 0.0
zs_ext_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_ext_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_ext_miss)
zs_hit_rate_extreme = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_ext_hit) / zs_ext_denom

# Moderate backwardation — ZS
zs_mod_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_mod) and zs_fwd_mod > 0) else 0.0
zs_mod_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_mod) and zs_fwd_mod <= 0) else 0.0
zs_mod_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_mod_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_mod_miss)
zs_hit_rate_mod = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_mod_hit) / zs_mod_denom

# --- % of days in each regime (expanding) ---
# ZC
zc_back_flag = 1.0 if zc_in_backwardation else 0.0
zc_cont_flag = 1.0 if zc_in_contango else 0.0
zc_total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_flag) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_cont_flag)
zc_pct_back = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_flag) / zc_total_days
zc_pct_cont = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_cont_flag) / zc_total_days

# ZS
zs_back_flag = 1.0 if zs_in_backwardation else 0.0
zs_cont_flag = 1.0 if zs_in_contango else 0.0
zs_total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_flag) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_cont_flag)
zs_pct_back = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_flag) / zs_total_days
zs_pct_cont = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_cont_flag) / zs_total_days

# =============================================================================
# QUINTILE SORT: Rolling 252-day percentrank → quintile 1-5
#   Q1 = deepest contango (pctrank <= 20)
#   Q2 = mild contango    (20 < pctrank <= 40)
#   Q3 = flat/neutral     (40 < pctrank <= 60)
#   Q4 = mild backwardation (60 < pctrank <= 80)
#   Q5 = deepest backwardation (pctrank > 80)
# =============================================================================

# ZC: rolling 252-day percentrank of carry
zc_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(zc_carry)
zc_quintile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(zc_pctrank) and zc_pctrank <= 20, 1,
    is_valid(zc_pctrank) and zc_pctrank <= 40, 2,
    is_valid(zc_pctrank) and zc_pctrank <= 60, 3,
    is_valid(zc_pctrank) and zc_pctrank <= 80, 4,
    is_valid(zc_pctrank), 5,
    0
)

# ZS: rolling 252-day percentrank of carry
zs_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(zs_carry)
zs_quintile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(zs_pctrank) and zs_pctrank <= 20, 1,
    is_valid(zs_pctrank) and zs_pctrank <= 40, 2,
    is_valid(zs_pctrank) and zs_pctrank <= 60, 3,
    is_valid(zs_pctrank) and zs_pctrank <= 80, 4,
    is_valid(zs_pctrank), 5,
    0
)

# --- Quintile-conditional forward carry (ZC) ---
zc_fwd_q1 = where(zc_quintile == 1, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_q2 = where(zc_quintile == 2, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_q3 = where(zc_quintile == 3, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_q4 = where(zc_quintile == 4, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_q5 = where(zc_quintile == 5, zc_fwd_carry_63)

# --- Quintile-conditional forward carry (ZS) ---
zs_fwd_q1 = where(zs_quintile == 1, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_q2 = where(zs_quintile == 2, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_q3 = where(zs_quintile == 3, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_q4 = where(zs_quintile == 4, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_q5 = where(zs_quintile == 5, zs_fwd_carry_63)

# --- Hit rate by quintile: % of days where 63d forward carry > 0 ---
# ZC
zc_q1_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q1) and zc_fwd_q1 > 0) else 0.0
zc_q1_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q1) and zc_fwd_q1 <= 0) else 0.0
zc_q1_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q1_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q1_miss)
zc_hr_q1 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q1_hit) / zc_q1_denom

zc_q2_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q2) and zc_fwd_q2 > 0) else 0.0
zc_q2_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q2) and zc_fwd_q2 <= 0) else 0.0
zc_q2_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q2_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q2_miss)
zc_hr_q2 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q2_hit) / zc_q2_denom

zc_q3_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q3) and zc_fwd_q3 > 0) else 0.0
zc_q3_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q3) and zc_fwd_q3 <= 0) else 0.0
zc_q3_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q3_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q3_miss)
zc_hr_q3 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q3_hit) / zc_q3_denom

zc_q4_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q4) and zc_fwd_q4 > 0) else 0.0
zc_q4_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q4) and zc_fwd_q4 <= 0) else 0.0
zc_q4_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q4_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q4_miss)
zc_hr_q4 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q4_hit) / zc_q4_denom

zc_q5_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q5) and zc_fwd_q5 > 0) else 0.0
zc_q5_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_q5) and zc_fwd_q5 <= 0) else 0.0
zc_q5_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q5_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q5_miss)
zc_hr_q5 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_q5_hit) / zc_q5_denom

# ZS
zs_q1_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q1) and zs_fwd_q1 > 0) else 0.0
zs_q1_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q1) and zs_fwd_q1 <= 0) else 0.0
zs_q1_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q1_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q1_miss)
zs_hr_q1 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q1_hit) / zs_q1_denom

zs_q2_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q2) and zs_fwd_q2 > 0) else 0.0
zs_q2_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q2) and zs_fwd_q2 <= 0) else 0.0
zs_q2_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q2_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q2_miss)
zs_hr_q2 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q2_hit) / zs_q2_denom

zs_q3_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q3) and zs_fwd_q3 > 0) else 0.0
zs_q3_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q3) and zs_fwd_q3 <= 0) else 0.0
zs_q3_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q3_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q3_miss)
zs_hr_q3 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q3_hit) / zs_q3_denom

zs_q4_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q4) and zs_fwd_q4 > 0) else 0.0
zs_q4_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q4) and zs_fwd_q4 <= 0) else 0.0
zs_q4_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q4_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q4_miss)
zs_hr_q4 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q4_hit) / zs_q4_denom

zs_q5_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q5) and zs_fwd_q5 > 0) else 0.0
zs_q5_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_q5) and zs_fwd_q5 <= 0) else 0.0
zs_q5_denom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q5_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q5_miss)
zs_hr_q5 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_q5_hit) / zs_q5_denom

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# --- Calendar month extraction (1–12) for seasonality heatmaps ---
bar_month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())

# =============================================================================
# SEASONALITY: % of days in each quintile by calendar month
#
# For each bar, emit 1.0 if the bar is in that quintile, else 0.0.
# x = month (1–12), y = quintile (1–5), value = 0/1 flag.
# The heatmap averages all bars sharing the same (month, quintile) cell,
# yielding the fraction of days in that month that fall in each quintile.
# =============================================================================



# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1a: Expanding Hit Rate — ZC (three-regime)
# Extreme backwardation vs moderate backwardation vs 50% coin-flip baseline
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn (ZC): Does Backwardation Tier Predict Positive 63d Carry? (Expanding Hit Rate)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% of Regime Days)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moderate Backwardation (0–5%)', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_hit_rate_extreme, zc_hit_rate_mod))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1b: Expanding Hit Rate — ZS (three-regime)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Does Backwardation Tier Predict Positive 63d Carry? (Expanding Hit Rate)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% of Regime Days)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moderate Backwardation (0–5%)', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_hit_rate_extreme, zs_hit_rate_mod))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1c: Avg 63d Forward Carry by Quintile — ZC
# Q1 = deepest contango → Q5 = deepest backwardation (rolling 252d percentrank)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Corn (ZC): Avg 63d Forward Carry by Carry Quintile (Q1=Deepest Contango, Q5=Deepest Backwardation)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(zc_fwd_q1, zc_fwd_q2, zc_fwd_q3, zc_fwd_q4, zc_fwd_q5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1d: Avg 63d Forward Carry by Quintile — ZS
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Avg 63d Forward Carry by Carry Quintile (Q1=Deepest Contango, Q5=Deepest Backwardation)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(zs_fwd_q1, zs_fwd_q2, zs_fwd_q3, zs_fwd_q4, zs_fwd_q5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1e: Hit Rate by Quintile — ZC
# % of days where 63d forward carry > 0, by carry quintile (expanding)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Corn (ZC): Hit Rate by Carry Quintile — Does Higher Backwardation Predict Positive 63d Carry?',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Days with Positive 63d Fwd Carry)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=4
)(zc_hr_q1, zc_hr_q2, zc_hr_q3, zc_hr_q4, zc_hr_q5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1f: Hit Rate by Quintile — ZS
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Hit Rate by Carry Quintile — Does Higher Backwardation Predict Positive 63d Carry?',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Days with Positive 63d Fwd Carry)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=5
)(zs_hr_q1, zs_hr_q2, zs_hr_q3, zs_hr_q4, zs_hr_q5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: ZC Carry Time Series — Regime Colored (three regimes)
# Blue = extreme backwardation (>5%), Cyan = moderate backwardation (0–5%), Red = contango
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn (ZC): Curve Slope — Extreme Back (Blue) / Moderate Back (Cyan) / Contango (Red)',
    category='2. Curve Slope',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat Curve'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.05, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Extreme Threshold (5%)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moderate Backwardation (0–5%)', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry_extreme, zc_carry_mod, zc_carry_cont))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: ZS Carry Time Series — Regime Colored (three regimes)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Curve Slope — Extreme Back (Blue) / Moderate Back (Cyan) / Contango (Red)',
    category='2. Curve Slope',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat Curve'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.05, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Extreme Threshold (5%)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moderate Backwardation (0–5%)', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
